Read what comes back: Changes your hold setting (setting:needs_you_hold) by your hold rules: set-aside needs a reason of the rules' length and lasts the rules' minutes, a few times a day; hand-back gives the rest of the thing to your AIs by one of the rules' ways and leaves the hold; choose-stake picks what turning off costs, in force once the stake before it has run its delay; turn-off takes effect only after the stake's delay and comes back by itself; turn-on is at once.
